phase: External Counterpart Source Semantic + Lineage Review — Sectoral Financial Positions
purpose: Pre-register the post-discovery review that must occur before any Eurostat or OECD counterpart source can be used to define an exact historical extraction for RMD. The review is metadata/semantics/lineage only: it may inspect retained discovery artifacts, source dimension/code metadata and official documentation, but it may not inspect value fit, reconciliation residuals or change RMD readiness.

semantic_sector_targets.H: Households plus NPISH; accept one exact published combined sector or an exact same-period sum of published household and NPISH sectors only.
semantic_sector_targets.F: Financial corporations excluding the central bank; accept exact published equivalent or exact same-period S12 minus S121 identity only when both source concepts are semantically compatible.

instrument_meanings.F6: Insurance, pension and standardised guarantee schemes
instrument_meanings.F7: Financial derivatives and employee stock options

frozen_rmd_target.preferred_unit: national currency with explicit scaling metadata
frozen_rmd_target.required_accounting_boundary: non-consolidated sector/counterpart positions and transactions compatible with the existing RMD reference boundary

review_questions.pass_condition: Every required RMD sector H,C,F,G,BNR,X has an explicit source-code construction justified by source labels/metadata, with no residual sector assignment and no post-result sector dropping.
The reporting-sector/counterpart-sector orientation is explicit for assets and liabilities so creditor/debtor direction cannot be inferred from numerical signs or reconciliation fit.

Every required RMD instrument F2-F8 has an exact source concept or an exact additive component construction fixed from source metadata. Broader financial-total or net-financial-asset measures cannot substitute for a missing instrument.

Closing positions and financial transactions are separately identified source concepts. Stock differences, revaluations, other-volume changes or total changes cannot substitute for financial transactions.
Asset/liability or acquisition/incurrence orientation is explicit from source metadata and may not be inferred from sign.
Unit and multiplier/scaling metadata are explicit and sufficient to construct one consistent national-currency unit without value-based reverse engineering.
The source boundary is demonstrated compatible with the non-consolidated RMD reference boundary; valuation conventions are recorded and no consolidated series is silently mixed into the target.
The dissemination/source lineage is recorded explicitly. Eurostat/ECB or OECD/ECB lineage cannot be described as independent validation merely because the dissemination endpoint differs.
